values.en: A λ-term is in weak head normal form when its outermost head requires no reduction: it is a λ-abstraction, or a variable or declared constant, possibly applied to arguments. Its body and arguments may still contain redexes.
values.zh-CN: 若一个 λ-项的最外层首部无需继续归约，即它是 λ-抽象，或是变量或已声明常量（可带若干参数），则称其为弱首标准型。其函数体和参数中仍可含有可约式。
